entries.answer:
Based on the research, **Modal** is the platform that comes closest to matching your criteria, though no single platform meets all three requirements simultaneously. Here is a detailed breakdown:

## Modal: The Closest Match

Modal is a serverless cloud computing platform designed for GPU-accelerated Python workloads. It offers a **Starter plan at $0/month** that includes **$30 in free compute credits every month**. No credit card is required to sign up — you authenticate via GitHub, Google, or SSO. If you exceed the $30 free allowance without a payment method on file, Modal simply stops your workloads rather than charging you, so there is no risk of surprise billing.[1]

Crucially for your third criterion, Modal announced in early 2026 that **NVIDIA B200 GPUs are now available to any Modal account holder** — no "contact sales" button, no quota request required. The B200s on Modal feature 180 GB of HBM3e memory, 8 TB/s of memory bandwidth, and support up to 8 GPUs per container (up to 1,536 GB of total GPU RAM in a single job). They are billed at **$6.25/hour**.[2][3][4]

## Where Modal Falls Short

The platform fully satisfies the **$30 free monthly credit with no payment required** criterion. However, the $30 free credit covers only about **~4.8 hours of B200 time** at $6.25/hr, so it does not stretch to $100 worth of B200 compute at no cost. The **$100 free compute with no payment info** criterion is not met on the Starter plan — that credit level ($100/month) is only included in the paid **Team plan at $250/month**.[5][6][1]

## Criteria Scorecard for Modal

| Criterion | Met? | Details |
|---|---|---|
| Free starter tier with ≥$30/month credit | ✅ Yes | $30/month on Starter plan [5] |
| No payment required until credit is spent | ✅ Yes | No credit card needed; workloads halt if exceeded [1] |
| Up to $100 free compute, no payment info | ❌ No | $100/month credit is on the paid $250/mo Team plan [5] |
| Access to multiple NVIDIA B200 GPUs | ✅ Yes | Up to 8x B200s per container, open to all accounts [2][3] |

## No Platform Meets All Three Simultaneously

As of April 2026, no known platform offers all three criteria together: a free tier with $100 in no-payment-required credits **and** NVIDIA B200 access. Platforms with generous free credits (Google Cloud's $300, Azure's $200, AWS's $200 ) all require a credit card on file during signup — they simply don't charge it until credits run out — and none of them currently offer NVIDIA B200 GPUs in their standard instance catalog. B200s remain cutting-edge hardware available only on specialized providers like Modal, Genesis Cloud, and a handful of others, none of which offer $100 in truly no-payment-required free credits.[7][8][9][10][11]

Modal remains the **best available option** if you are willing to accept the $30/month free tier (without payment required) combined with genuine open-access B200 availability — it uniquely satisfies three out of four of your criteria with no friction.
